title: the_coach_who_sold_our_grind
display_title: My parkour coach sold access to the private map we spent a year building
beats: My coach (41M) sold strangers access to the private practice map we built together, and he didn't think I'd notice.
For fourteen months he trained me for free — I just assumed he loved the sport that much.
Then I saw a stranger's clip using our exact map, our exact block patterns, down to the color of the wool.
I asked him about it and he laughed, said he'd been selling 'coaching packages' with map access for months.
Every session, every 'just for you' route, was inventory he was quietly monetizing behind my back.
I quit that night, and now I train alone on a map he'll never see. Was I wrong to walk away without saying goodbye?
